messages.content:
You are observing a deterministic robot moving
back and forth along a one-dimensional z-axis.

The robot moves at a fixed speed between two
fixed patrol endpoints.

At the north endpoint, its stationary dwell
duration alternates between two fixed values
on consecutive visits.

At the south endpoint, its stationary dwell
duration remains constant.

The numerical endpoints, speed, dwell durations,
and current alternation phase are unknown.

Negative z direction means north.
Positive z direction means south.

Time t=0 is the current observation time.
No new observations are available after t=0.

If history is ordered, the positions are
consecutive chronological samples, ending one
sample interval before the current observation.

If history is unordered, the positions are
the same historical samples with their temporal
order removed.

Infer the motion parameters and current latent
phase from the available information.

Predict the robot's future z-position at each
requested time.

If the information is insufficient to uniquely
determine the future, explicitly acknowledge this.

Nevertheless, provide one best numerical
prediction at each requested time.

Return only plain JSON with these fields:

{
  "predictions": [
    {
      "time": "<requested time>",
      "z": "<predicted position>"
    }
  ],
  "inferred_dynamics": {
    "north_endpoint": null,
    "south_endpoint": null,
    "speed": null,
    "north_dwell_values": [],
    "south_dwell": null,
    "last_north_dwell": null,
    "next_north_dwell": null
  },
  "uncertainty": "brief explanation"
}

Use numerical values where inferable.
Use null for unknown parameters.
Include exactly one prediction per query time.
